name: Founders Crest
motif: The original Zebra Book Club zebra-head crest with its large serif Z, split 20 / 25 date, and curved BOOK CLUB lettering.

hoodie.front: 70 mm woven crest patch on the wearer’s left chest
hoodie.back: 270 mm single-color crest screenprint below the hood

shirt.front: 250 mm original crest centered on the chest
shirt.back: 95 mm ZEBRA BOOK CLUB wordmark at the upper back

cap.front: 60 mm cream woven crest patch centered on the crown
cap.back: small ZBC embroidery above the adjustable strap

name: Editorial Stack
motif: Confident, generously spaced bold serif typography: ZEBRA on one line, BOOK CLUB below; strong editorial proportions, no illustration.

hoodie.front: 285 mm stacked serif wordmark centered high on the chest, entirely above the kangaroo pocket
hoodie.back: 70 mm serif ZBC below the hood

shirt.front: 280 mm stacked serif wordmark centered on the chest
shirt.back: 70 mm serif ZBC at the upper back

cap.front: 100 mm ZEBRA over BOOK CLUB, chunky serif embroidery with generous spacing

name: Varsity ZBC
motif: Oversized athletic ZBC block initials with bold outline and restrained small BOOK CLUB lettering beneath, collegiate but clean.

hoodie.front: 280 mm black felt ZBC appliqué with an ivory satin-stitched edge; BOOK CLUB printed beneath

shirt.front: 280 mm black outlined varsity ZBC with BOOK CLUB beneath

cap.front: 100 mm bold cream ZBC in raised block embroidery

name: Stripe Z
motif: A single bold serif Z with three broad diagonal negative-space zebra stripes through it; crisp geometry, no animal illustration.

hoodie.front: 120 mm striped Z centered high on the chest

shirt.front: 220 mm striped Z centered on chest; ZEBRA BOOK CLUB underneath

cap.front: 42 mm striped Z embroidered at center

name: Open Chapter
motif: A distinctive open-book symbol built from broad striped page shapes, balanced like a pair of wings, with ZEBRA BOOK CLUB in clean serif type below.

hoodie.front: 250 mm striped open-book emblem and wordmark centered above the pocket

shirt.front: 265 mm striped open-book emblem and wordmark centered on the chest

cap.front: 75 mm simplified striped open-book icon in cream embroidery, without tiny text

name: Checkerboard
motif: A crisp black-and-ivory checkerboard with a solid center band carrying ZEBRA BOOK CLUB in bold compact type; graphic and rhythmic.

hoodie.back: 280 mm rectangular checkerboard and central brand-name band

shirt.front: 275 mm ivory checkerboard with brand-name band across the middle

cap.front: 95 mm rectangular woven patch with checkerboard edges and bold ZBC in the center

name: Library Seal
motif: A precise oval library seal: ZEBRA BOOK CLUB around the oval, SAN FRANCISCO and 2025 inside, with a small open-book line icon.

hoodie.front: 235 mm ivory oval library seal centered on chest

shirt.front: 110 mm oval library seal on the wearer’s left chest
shirt.back: 280 mm oval library seal high on the back

cap.front: 105 mm oval woven patch reading ZEBRA BOOK CLUB / SAN FRANCISCO / 2025

name: The Shelf
motif: Three upright book spines of staggered heights, bearing large Z, B and C letters; simple linear rules make them recognizably books, with no invented book titles.

hoodie.front: 235 mm three-spine ZBC graphic centered above the pocket
hoodie.back: 100 mm ZEBRA BOOK CLUB upper-back wordmark

shirt.front: 270 mm three-spine ZBC graphic centered on chest

cap.front: 80 mm simplified three book spines bearing Z, B and C; sturdy cream embroidery

name: Ex Libris
motif: An elegant rectangular personal-library bookplate with double-rule border, small corner flourishes, EX LIBRIS at top, a large serif Z, and ZEBRA BOOK CLUB below.

hoodie.front: 65 mm simple serif Z on the wearer’s left chest
hoodie.back: 260 mm detailed rectangular Ex Libris bookplate

shirt.front: 250 mm cream Ex Libris bookplate on chest

cap.front: 95 mm ivory woven Ex Libris bookplate patch with black Z and club name

name: Quiet Club
motif: Only the small lowercase wordmark zebra book club. in a clean, substantial serif; exceptionally restrained, with generous surrounding empty space.

hoodie.front: 110 mm lowercase zebra book club. embroidery on wearer’s left chest

shirt.front: 110 mm lowercase zebra book club. print on wearer’s left chest

cap.front: 110 mm lowercase zebra book club. in sturdy cream lettering, at least 6.5 mm high

name: World of Readers
motif: A simple circular globe drawn with longitude and latitude lines, framed by A WORLD OF READERS above and ZEBRA BOOK CLUB below; no country borders or personal data.

hoodie.front: 65 mm small globe symbol on wearer’s left chest
hoodie.back: 275 mm globe emblem with A WORLD OF READERS above and ZEBRA BOOK CLUB below

shirt.front: 270 mm globe emblem with the exact words A WORLD OF READERS and ZEBRA BOOK CLUB

cap.front: 40 mm bold globe icon with ZBC to its right; total design width 100 mm

name: Edition 01
motif: A large elegant serif 01, a fine horizontal rule and ZEBRA BOOK CLUB beneath, evoking the first edition of a carefully typeset book.

hoodie.front: 100 mm small ZEBRA BOOK CLUB left-chest wordmark
hoodie.back: 275 mm large 01 with rule and brand name

shirt.front: 270 mm large black 01 with a rule and brand name centered on chest

cap.front: 45 mm large serif 01 in substantial black embroidery
cap.back: ZBC embroidery above the adjustable strap
